name: Taking Care Of Your Body
overview: Scripture teaches that our bodies are created in the image of God, calling us to honor Him by presenting our bodies as living sacrifices, holy and acceptable. While Jesus instructs us not to be anxious about physical needs, we are also warned to guard against overindulgence and the cares of life that can weigh down our hearts. True care for our bodies involves a transformed mind that discerns God's perfect will, supported by prayer and thanksgiving rather than worry.
